name: ai-workflow
description: AI engineering pipeline with /workshop (spec approval), /orchestrator (orchestrated design→implement→review→QA→document), /audit (codebase audit), and optional Jev advisory signals (PR triage, stalled-loop check, spec check). Includes ticket-reviewer, designer, backend/frontend engineers, code-reviewer, qa-tester, and writer agents.
